thread_text:
Priya Patel: heads up — drafting a short reactive play for mid-market accounts that drop below 40% usage month-over-month. want quick alignment on steps.
Ben Ortiz: thanks. agreed we need a 24-48h triage. minimal checklist pls.
Priya Patel: high level: 1) immediate health pull 2) outreach + guided enablement 3) short-term incentives 4) downgrade safe path 5) 30d follow-up.
Marisol Gomez: add 'success gap snapshot' — key dashboards + top 3 missing features they tried. share sample email.
Liam Chen: sample outreach script:
```
Hey <customer>, noticed usage dipped. Can we hop 20m to review quick wins? We'll prep a tailored checklist and a migration plan if needed.
```
Nora (CS Ops): SQL to get last 90d active endpoints and token spend:
```
SELECT account_id, sum(tokens) AS tokens_90d, count(distinct user_id) AS uniq_users FROM events WHERE timestamp > now() - interval '90 days' GROUP BY account_id;
```
Priya Patel: love it. who volunteers to own play doc + templated emails?
Ben Ortiz: I can own doc + one-pager.
Marisol Gomez: i'll produce the enablement checklist and short Looms.
Liam Chen: i'll wire up the dashboard and an alert rule (usage_drop >30% over 2 weeks).
Priya Patel: escalation ladder: if top-3 engagement fixes don't lift usage in 14 days => propose credit + one-month pilot of dedicated onboarding. if they elect downgrade, apply 'downgrade-protect' to preserve recent configs and offer re-up price.
Ben Ortiz: proposed email for downgrade path:
```
Subject: Options to keep things running smoothly — a simple downgrade path
Body: we can shift you to a lower tier (no data loss), keep X features for 30 days, and give 1:1 office hours to re-onboard if you return.
```
Marisol Gomez: add “success checklist” to keep dataset & prompts intact during downgrade.
Priya Patel: measurement: track 1) 14-day re-engage pct 2) churn avoided % 3) time-to-first-success after outreach. Nora can we add these to CS ops dashboard?
Nora (CS Ops): yep. i'll add metrics and a weekly pipeline view. will tag accounts with_reason=stitchback.
onboard-bot: doc created -> https://docs.redwood/internals/stitchback-play (owners: Ben Ortiz, Marisol Gomez)
Priya Patel: timeline: publish draft by EOD Thurs, run a pilot on 3 accounts next week. quick sync Thu 11am?
Ben Ortiz: 11am works. :raised_hands:
Liam Chen: I'll drop the dashboard link in the doc before sync.
Marisol Gomez: putting Looms in doc now. :sparkles:
Priya Patel: perfect. thanks team — this is our standard 'stitchback' save flow. keeping it short and prescriptive so CSMs can run it in 30-60m.
Ben Ortiz: copy that. will prep templates.
